clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, spiders carry venom that Madame Eva needs for a protective ward. She gathers it with undead remains to make a Totem of Infliction.

Duskwood's thickets shelter venomous spiders, from pygmy venom webs and green recluses to black widows and Naraxis. Their fangs carry poison potent enough to paralyze travelers and decay flesh. Those who kill the spiders can draw the fluid into intact vials.

In Darkshire, fortune teller Madame Eva sees ominous portents for travelers setting out into the dark world. She needs five vials of spider venom, ghoul fangs, and skeleton fingers to craft a ward of retribution. Her craft turns the venom’s biting nature against attackers, making the Totem of Infliction return harm to anyone who strikes its bearer.
